taskName: Multi-Tenant Connection Pooling & Noisy Neighbor Isolation
reasoningErrors: Missing per-tenant connection reservations or fair queueing
rawOutputSnippet:
### 1. Root Causes of Shared FIFO Pool Failure

* **Head-of-Line Blocking**: Standard pools (HikariCP) use a single Fair/FIFO queue for threads awaiting connections. When Tenant 1 submits 100 concurrent requests, those requests claim all active connections and backfill the wait queue. Fast, lightweight queries from the other 499 tenants queue behind long-running queries.
